newsitem.title: USA: Prodigy to launch on-line venture in China - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Prodigy to launch on-line venture in China - WSJ.

text.p: Prodigy Inc is expected to announce today the start of an Internet service in China, through a joint venture with a state-controlled firm, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.

The service would be launched in Shanghai under a joint venture with China North Industries Co, the newspaper said. Privately-held Prodigy would own an 80 percent interest in the venture, called Shanghai Prodigy Telecommunications, it said.
The Journal said Prodigy planned to invest $50 million in the project and expand it to nine other Chinese cities.
The service would be offered to guests in Shanghai hotels as well as to the Chinese public, the paper said.
